// Inject the close-wait error into a real child that ignores SIGTERM.
// Keep module mocking in this subprocess, isolated from other test suites.
import { mock } from "bun:test";
import * as cp from "node:child_process";
import { mkdtempSync, mkdirSync, writeFileSync, readFileSync, chmodSync, rmSync } from "node:fs";
import { join, resolve } from "node:path";
import { tmpdir } from "node:os";
const originalSpawn = cp.spawn;
let pid: number | undefined;
mock.module("node:child_process", () => ({
  ...cp,
  spawn: (...args: Parameters<typeof cp.spawn>) => {
    const child = originalSpawn(...args);
    if (String(args[0]).endsWith("rpc.sh")) {
      pid = child.pid;
      child.stdout!.on("data", (data) => {
        if (String(data).includes("agent_start"))
          setTimeout(() => child.emit("error", new Error("injected close-wait error")), 10);
      });
    }
    return child;
  },
}));
const home = mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), "owner-error-repro-"));
process.env.HOME = home;
try {
  mkdirSync(join(home, ".bruv"));
  writeFileSync(join(home, ".bruv", "subagents.json"), JSON.stringify({ normal: { model: "example/model" } }));
  const repo = join(home, "repo");
  mkdirSync(repo);
  mkdirSync(join(repo, ".git"));
  const owner = await import(resolve(process.argv[2]!));
  const hello = await owner.handleRemoteRequest({ op: "hello" });
  await owner.handleRemoteRequest(
    { op: "launch", taskId: "repro", ownerId: hello.ownerId, epoch: hello.epoch, repoPath: repo, prompt: "test" },
    "/bin/true",
  );
  const directory = join(home, ".bruv", "remote-owner", "tasks", "repro");
  const path = join(directory, "state.json");
  const state = JSON.parse(readFileSync(path, "utf8"));
  state.pid = process.pid;
  state.startTime = readFileSync("/proc/" + process.pid + "/stat", "utf8")
    .split(") ")[1]!
    .split(" ")[19];
  state.task.state = "accepted";
  writeFileSync(path, JSON.stringify(state));
  const rpc = join(directory, "rpc.sh");
  writeFileSync(
    rpc,
    `#!/bin/sh
read command
echo '{"type":"response","id":"remote-config","success":true,"data":{"model":{"provider":"example","id":"model"},"thinkingLevel":"off"}}'
read command
trap '' TERM
echo '{"type":"agent_start"}'
while :; do sleep 0.01; done
`,
  );
  chmodSync(rpc, 0o700);
  const started = Date.now();
  await owner.runOwnerTask("repro", rpc);
  let alive = false;
  try {
    process.kill(pid!, 0);
    alive = true;
  } catch {}
  console.log(
    JSON.stringify({
      owner: process.argv[2],
      elapsedMs: Date.now() - started,
      childAliveAfterReturn: alive,
      task: JSON.parse(readFileSync(path, "utf8")).task,
    }),
  );
} finally {
  if (pid) {
    try {
      process.kill(pid, "SIGKILL");
    } catch {}
  }
  rmSync(home, { recursive: true, force: true });
}
